profile.name: Ocean Insight 光纤光谱仪
profile.description: 一种通过 USB 连接的紧凑型光纤光谱仪，用于测量不同波长处的光强分布。实验室中常用于光源与样品的光谱表征，例如透射、反射或发射测量，并可通过调节积分时间适配不同信号强度。
profile.description_en: A compact USB-connected fiber-optic spectrometer used to measure light intensity as a function of wavelength. In laboratories it is commonly used for spectral characterization of light sources and samples, such as transmission, reflection, or emission measurements, with adjustable integration time for different signal levels.

registry.name: Ocean Insight No Spectrometer Connected
registry.description: OI Spectrometer是由Ocean Insight生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化、数据保存、状态查询、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, display等操作。
